summary: This profile outlines the coding conventions used in the legacy VB6 codebase, focusing on naming, error handling, and security practices.

rules.rule: Form names should be descriptive and reflect their purpose.
Use structured error handling with On Error statements.

lint_recommendations: Ensure all forms have descriptive names.
Implement structured error handling in all event handlers.
scaffold_templates: C# class templates for forms with event handlers.
C# data access layer using Entity Framework.
